title: Existence of sectionwise action maps
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], B and C sheaves of commutative O_Y-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], phi:B to C an O_Y-algebra morphism, and P a sheaf of B-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Put P0=P restricted to O_Y, S=C.toModule tensor_O P0, F=B.toModule tensor_O S, and T=(C tensor_B P) restricted to O_Y [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let tau be the canonical tensor-section map and eta the change-of-rings presheaf sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. There exist O_Y-module morphisms a,d:F to S and g:S to T such that a_W(tau(b,tau(c,p)))=tau(c,bp), d_W(tau(b,tau(c,p)))=tau(phi_W(b)c,p), and g_W(tau(c,p))=eta_W(c tensor_B p) for every open W, b in B(W), c in C(W), and p in P(W).

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma 01SB (morphisms-lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), change of rings assertion; Sheaves, Lemma 0089 (sheaves-lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules); explicit tensor-balancing argument in steps 1-4 of lem-weil-pbc-change-of-rings-tensor-relation-presentation

proof.text: Use the two-action construction to obtain a and d with the first two section formulas.

Obtain the presheaf comparison h. Extend h through the O_Y-module sheafification adjunction, and precompose by tensorObjIsoSheafification.hom to define g on the sheaf tensor. On a pure tensor, cancel the comparison isomorphism with its inverse in the definition of tmulSection. The adjunction hom-equivalence unit identity then identifies the value of g with h, whose formula gives the required change-of-rings value.
Package a,d,g and their three formulas into ChangeOfRingsTensorActionFormulas.

mathlib_searches.results: PresheafOfModules.Monoidal.tensorObj and tensorObjMap, and PresheafOfModules.Sheafify.smul and SMulCandidate. These supply constructions, not the three-map existence theorem.
The sheafification hom-equivalence and its unit formulas exist. They are the universal-property ingredient, not the specialized existence theorem.

msearch grep found sheafificationHomEquiv in Mathlib. Local rg found the target, but no independent action-map existence theorem. Private tensor_hom_ext and tensor_triple_hom_ext in ModulePullbackTensorCoherence give a model for the balancing proof.

theorem exists_changeOfRings_tensor_action_maps_core (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (φ : B ⟶ C)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B.right)) :
    ∃ (a d : tensorObj B.toModule (tensorObj C.toModule
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P)) ⟶
      tensorObj C.toModule ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P))
      (g : tensorObj C.toModule ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 C.hom)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} φ.right P)),
      ChangeOfRingsTensorActionFormulas Y B C φ P a d g
